newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Newspaper costs Antwerp man eight million francs.
newsitem.headline: Newspaper costs Antwerp man eight million francs.

text.p: An Antwerp man who parked to buy a newspaper found on returning to his car that thieves had grabbed a briefcase containing eight million francs ($210,000) in gold and jewels, Belga news agency reported on Wednesday.
The unnamed man, who works for a diamond firm in Antwerp -- the biggest diamond trading centre in the world -- stopped to drop into a nearby shop to buy the paper.
When he came out he saw his car window had been smashed and two men making off with the loot. The two escaped in a Dutch-registered car and have not been seen since.
